action_atlas.neighbor_distance: L2 over first-four non-gripper coordinates divided by coordinatewise training standard deviation clipped below at 0.001
action_atlas.pca: SVD of standardized residuals around the frozen ACT base chunk; first two right singular vectors; one grid unit equals the sample standard deviation of neighbor scores on that direction
action_atlas.candidate_clipping: clip every physical action coordinate to the environment action-space bounds after adding the residual
action_atlas.gripper_policy: copy the frozen ACT base chunk exactly

outcome.continuous_effect_distance: root mean square of scaled object translation, object rotation, and normalized progress-delta differences
outcome.recoverable: short_horizon_success OR (no collision AND no unintended contact AND normalized progress delta >= -0.05)
outcome.boundary: categorical class differs OR continuous effect distance >= 1.0
outcome.alias: categorical class equal AND continuous effect distance < 0.25

visual_atlas.camera_scope: all RGB cameras in frozen observation order
visual_atlas.local_low_resolution: downsample tile to 2x2 and bilinearly upsample to the original tile extent
visual_atlas.local_blur: Gaussian kernel 9 sigma 3 applied to the full image, copied only into the selected tile
visual_atlas.conditional_mean: replace tile by the per-camera per-channel mean of its one-pixel outside ring
visual_atlas.action_ranking_proxy: nearest 5x5 physical action cell to the intervened first-four action chunk in the same standardized non-gripper coordinates
visual_atlas.realized_outcome: execute the intervened frozen-ACT first four actions from the exact restored state
visual_atlas.important_pair: nearest action-cell identity changes OR realized categorical class changes OR realized continuous effect distance from the unmodified base is at least 1.0

joint_probe.visual_selection: for each tile retain the intervention with maximum raw first-four action-chunk L2 change, ties by intervention_order; select four distinct tiles by descending retained change, ties by tile index
joint_probe.action_selection: five cells by descending original-state outcome utility, ties by grid index
joint_probe.joint_action: add each selected original PCA-cell residual to the visually intervened frozen-ACT base chunk and execute four steps from the exact restored state
joint_probe.joint_boundary: at least one selected visual intervention changes the utility-maximizing identity among the same five physical PCA cells
joint_probe.best_action_recall: full-fine best identity is present in the evaluated candidate set
joint_probe.outcome_regret: full-fine best utility minus candidate-set best utility

statistics.bootstrap: paired percentile over frozen state identity
